stem_book: Two beads of mass m and 2m are connected by a massless rod of length R and threaded onto a smooth circular wire of radius R. When the wire rotates uniformly with angular velocity ω about a vertical diameter, the beads do not slide on it and the rod remains vertical as shown (m above, 2m below). What must be the angular velocity ω (in rad/s) of the wire? (Take R = 15 m and g = 10 m/s².)
reason: added g = 10 m/s² (needed for the integer answer)
work: beads at r = √3R/2, ±R/2: N₁ = mω²R, N₂ = 2mω²R; rod force F = mg + N₁/2 = N₂/2 − 2mg ⇒ mω²R/2 = 3mg ⇒ ω² = 6g/R = 4 ⇒ ω = 2 rad/s
